# oakilydokily

**Veterinary professional services site. Multi-auth. ESIGN-compliant. Zero JavaScript. Pure Rust.**

Axum server with Google/Facebook/Apple OAuth, ESIGN-compliant liability waivers, federal compliance docs, and AI sprite generation at `/api/forge` via SSH to [pixel-forge](https://github.com/cochranblock/pixel-forge) on [kova](https://github.com/cochranblock/kova) GPU nodes.

---

## Run It

```bash
cargo run -p oakilydokily --features approuter
cargo build --release -p oakilydokily --features approuter
cargo run -p oakilydokily --bin oakilydokily-test --features tests
```

See [`.env.example`](.env.example) for all configuration options. Full build, test, and verification commands in [PROOF_OF_ARTIFACTS.md](PROOF_OF_ARTIFACTS.md).
